title: Introduction
content: Welcome to the Axon documentation. Axon is a decentralized privacy infrastructure designed to provide secure, anonymous networking for everyone.

title: Getting Started
content: To start using Axon, you can download the client for your platform or use the CLI for advanced configuration.

title: API Reference
content: The following endpoints allow nodes to register, send heartbeats, and fetch healthy nodes from the network.

endpoints.title: Registry API
endpoints.description: Registers or unregisters a proxy node in the Axon network. When registering (status: 1), the server responds with a 202 Accepted and asynchronously contacts the node to verify its identity.

endpoints.title: Heartbeat API
endpoints.description: Nodes must continuously ping this endpoint to prove they are alive. The node must provide the secret key it received during the asynchronous verification challenge.

endpoints.title: Nodes API
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all currently active and healthy proxy nodes in the network.
